summary.plain: The international group, from France, Russia, the UK, the US, Japan, the Czech and Slovak republics, Ukraine and Finland, that built and ran NEMO-3.
summary.technical: Collaboration with 26 listed affiliations on the final-results paper (arXiv:1506.05825) that operated NEMO-3 at LSM; the SuperNEMO calorimeter paper (arXiv:2412.18021) lists a 'NEMO-3/SuperNEMO collaboration' participant.
